title: Rameses II
summary: King listed in CFAH-9 Table 2 (Egypt Dynasties 19 and 26).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasties 19 and 26. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-9 (Table 2, "Integrated Chronology of Dynasties 19 and 26"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start: 644; End: 678). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-9: The 19th and 26th Dynasties of Egypt," OSF preprint v1.4 (25 Sep 2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/HV3B2, file CFAH-9_Dynasties_19_and_26_v1.4.pdf, Table 2 "Integrated Chronology of Dynasties 19 and 26", p. 58
reign.note: Row "Rameses II" of Table 2 (Egypt Dynasties 19 and 26). The table's last year (678) is earlier than its first (644), so only the first is used for the timeline.
